annotations.shape: a Date claiming 2025-03-04T08:00:00Z with a two-hop Received chain entering at 12:00 and leaving at 12:05: the claimed send time is earlier than every hop -- TimeEvent conflict case 1 of 5 (D15)
annotations.generator: tools/make_fixtures.py, from _fixture_date_before_hops (every timestamp pinned; the fixture exists for its evidence, not its bytes)
annotations.phase_numbering: the design document's phases: 0 = the Phase 0 skeleton walker, 1 = the Phase 1 parser, 2 = routing and statuses, 3 = threading and time evidence -- every time.* fact here is phase 3 (D15's TimeEvent evidence and the named ordering policies)
annotations.the_evidence: time.evidence rows are written in emailextract/timeevent.py's shape: event_id, doc_id (this message's container hash), parent_event_id, kind, when_raw, when_utc and offset as value-or-unknown_reason, offset_origin, precision, ambiguity, source (exactly one of field|property|part, with ordinal and span), trust, usable_for_arrival_ordering
annotations.the_policies: time.orders gives the order under each named policy over the fixture's own evidence: header_date_claimed sorts the arrival-usable events with known times by their claimed UTC (the claims, never merged); received_chain_header_order places the hops by header position alone -- the last-listed Received is the first hop, so the chain runs bottom-up and timestamps never reorder it; owner_manifest is the hand-labelled total-order override in time.owner_manifest and is not evidence-ranked (D15: no privileged ordering, the caller names policies, no default)
annotations.the_conflicts: time.unresolved_pairs lists every pair of claims that disagree or cannot be compared, returned beside whichever order ran (D15: evidence is never merged into one true time); time.evidence_conflicts states whether the fixture's evidence conflicts at all, and the pair list must be non-empty exactly when it does
annotations.labels_are_typed: the evidence, the orders and the pairs were typed by a model from D2/D15 and the fixture's declared shape, never copied out of a run of tests/support/timeline_ref.py (which exists to check these rows) or of the library; labels_provenance is spec

value: the Date claims 2025-03-04T08:00:00Z while the chain's first hop enters at 2025-03-04T12:00:00Z: two source families name two different moments for the same message and no policy merges them (D15, evidence is never merged into one true time)
the Date claims 2025-03-04T08:00:00Z while the chain's last hop stamps 2025-03-04T12:05:00Z: the claimed send time and the hop disagree about the message's moment and nothing reconciles them
